close_reason: fixed: removed MAX_FETCH_ALL cap from test backend get_objects; ids=None now returns all objects
description: common/mod.rs MAX_FETCH_ALL=500 silently truncates when ids=None. The debug_assert fires in debug builds (printing a warning to stderr) but in release tests (cargo test --release) or when the test spawns more than 500 objects, assertions are silently dropped and tests pass against a truncated object set. The Mailbox/set destroy loop uses ids=None to fetch all emails for a mailbox, so any test that creates more than 500 emails will silently miss some. Because the truncation happens in the test backend not the library code, a failing test will look like a handler bug not a test infrastructure bug.
title: MemoryBackend::get_objects ids=None silently truncates at MAX_FETCH_ALL=500
